Hi,
I live in the subdivision in Players Walk Holly Hills in Ijamsville. The road Ritchie Drive is a speed violation road. I currently only see one sign ( near the Holly Hills Club) turning on Ritchie from Mussetter that is posted at 25 mph. 
Car speeds on that road are extremely fast and whip around the curve.  I pass cars coming home. I am concern for public and wildlife safety. I would guess speeds up to 50 mph plus. Also, residents do walk the sides of the road. If possible, could you post more 25 mph signs or put a speed monitor to collect data.  I believe the one sign is not sufficient. 
Also, outside of Ritchie and Musseter/Ijamsville Road the bushes are overgrowing where the cars that quickly come down Ijamsville Road are not seen if you are looking to turn left. Sorry for two requests. The first one is more important.

Thanks,
Michelle
